capabilities: Sync Readwise Reader documents and reading progress
Show a reading heatmap and progress dashboard
Plan reading order on a tag-based board and Gantt timeline
Create linked highlight notes and inbox notes from highlights
Manage Reader tags, uploads, and Later/Inbox/Archive state
extras: Full-history sync is rate-limited; PDF and EPUB daily activity may be approximate because Readwise does not always expose exact reading sessions. The token is stored locally and calls go directly to the Readwise API.
intentEvidence: Readwise Reading Tracker is designed to work together with the official Readwise Obsidian plugin.
problem: Readwise reading progress and highlights sit outside Obsidian, so there is no local view of what has been read, what comes next, or how long the remaining books will take.

relations.evidence: Readwise Reading Tracker is designed to work together with the official Readwise Obsidian plugin.
AI answers are optional and go through the separate Codex Bridge plugin (plugin id free-solo-codex-bridge)

summary: Dashboard plugin that syncs Readwise Reader documents and shows reading progress, a daily heatmap, a tag-based planning board, and a Gantt reading plan.
